plan: Represent the working recipe as a deep copy so adapt() never mutates inputs; print_original() is a passthrough of authored_text.
Compute one global Fraction scale = target_yield / recipe yield and apply it to every ingredient quantity up front; substitution quantity_factors multiply on top.
Index the catalog by the 'for' name with candidates sorted by (priority, catalog index) so the winning choice is deterministic with catalog order as tie-breaker.

Resolve each excluded ingredient with an iterative chain loop: pick the best catalog choice, rewrite name/quantity/unit/preparation, record the choice id; a seen-set detects cycles ('substitution cycle involving NAME') and a missing candidate yields 'no substitution for NAME'.

Feed additional_ingredients from substitution results into the same processing worklist (scaled to the target yield) so they face the same exclusions and catalog choices, enabling chained adaptations.

Accumulate wording edits as ordered (old, new) pairs: an automatic pair for each name replacement plus explicit wording_changes; apply them to instruction strings only when assembling the adapted recipe.

Track equipment as a mutable list modified by add/remove entries in substitution results; after all substitutions, report every item missing from available_equipment as 'equipment NAME unavailable' and emit the final list sorted.

Collect reasons in a set across all ingredients, components, and the equipment check so every independently applicable reason is returned, sorted; on impossibility return recipe=None with considered choices.

Handle optional components by capturing their reasons locally: if adaptation fails, roll back their side effects and omit them with a sorted warning instead of failing the whole recipe; required components merge reasons.
Accumulate substitution yield_factors and compensate all quantities at the end so the adapted recipe stays exactly at target_yield, with a warning.
Embed the executable acceptance contract as assertions in a __main__ block using fractions.Fraction only.
mechanisms: deep-copy working recipe for input immutability
single global Fraction yield-scale applied before substitution factors
catalog index keyed by 'for' name sorted by (priority, catalog order)
iterative substitution-chain resolution with seen-set cycle detection
worklist queue so additional ingredients re-enter exclusion/substitution processing
ordered wording-pair accumulation applied to instructions only at assembly time
exhaustive reason set collected across ingredients, components, and equipment, sorted on return
snapshot-and-rollback omission of unadaptable optional components with warnings
yield_factor accumulation with compensating quantity rescale to hold target yield
authored_text passthrough for byte-for-byte original printing
